i01: Not so very long from now, people stopped building things... and started growing them.
i02: A tiny seed could hold a whole design. Plant it, and the land would grow into its shape, block by block by block.
i03: Nature and machines grew into each other. Trees grew bark of carbon lattice, and leaves of solar film that drank the sunlight.
i04: Vines carried data like little rivers of light. The beaches turned to mirror sand...
i05: ...and deep in the ocean, the kelp grew into servers, humming softly in the blue.
i06: Then, one day, the growers went quiet. Nobody is quite sure where they went.
i07: But the wild kept on growing.
i08: And now, you're awake. You have a fabricator kit, and a suit that runs on light.
i09: When the sun goes down, your power starts to droop, so build somewhere bright before the night comes.
i10: This whole world is waiting for someone to look after it. Go on, grower. Plant your seed.
